height_rule: Maximum height above the common floor datum, independently of selected semantic category
GT_source: Exact planar cell clipping of independent room 9 annotated triangles plus added object asset meshes. Ceiling triangles excluded before height/semantic reduction.
prediction_source: Eight raw depth reconstructions; semantics queried from losslessly reloaded original OneMap feature grid. Predicted ceiling/unknown/unmapped labels excluded before height/semantic reduction.

category_mapping.large_objects: All remaining annotated semantic classes, including walls, furniture, objects and misc; excluding ceiling.

semantic_formula: 100 * number of GT-valid XY cells with identical three-class labels / number of GT-valid XY cells. Missing prediction counts as incorrect.
height_formula: 100 * mean(abs(pred_max_height - GT_max_height)) on GT-valid cells with a valid predicted height; units cm. Missing cells excluded from MAE and included as semantic errors.
domain: GT cells with at least one input depth hit. Ceiling-filtered saved labels remain errors. Predictions outside the GT domain are not scored.
limitations: Semantic categories are mapped after upstream OneMap feature fusion; original OneMap cannot separate classes by height within one planar cell.
Priority can hide small objects sharing an XY cell with a large object.
Small objects are the three added asset classes, not a physical size threshold.
No true stair surfaces in this room; floor_stairs measures floor only.
For predicted height, ceiling removal relies on predicted semantics, not GT masks; a ceiling misclassified as another class can still inflate predicted height.
